---
title: "Season 8 artifact swap"
type: learnings
description: "season 8 artifact ids stay blocked until the artifacts datamine is refreshed"
project: gamehelper
tags: [season, artifacts]
---

The artifact table cannot adopt a new season set until the artifacts datamine mirror is
refreshed: the ids it would map to do not exist yet, so season 8 keeps showing the season 7
set even after the release.
